description: Convert a Word .docx file to clean Markdown. Headings, bold/italic, strikethrough, links, ordered/nested lists, code blocks, and blockquotes become Markdown; tables are kept as HTML. Native Word equations (OMML) are restored as LaTeX — inline $...$, display $$...$$. Optionally also writes the .md to disk.

output_path.description: Optional path to also write the Markdown result to.

name: docx_to_markdown
